title: Notch-Peak Filter
text: Design second-order tunable notching and peaking IIR filter, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Filter output} sets Filter response to output Notch and; {Filter specification} sets the filter design specifications Bandwidth and center, {Specify bandwidth from input port} sets the option to specify 3 dB bandwidth from input, {3 dB bandwidth} sets the 3-dB bandwidth, {Specify center frequency from input port} sets the option to specify center frequency from input, {Center frequency of notch or peak} sets the notch or peak center frequency, {Specify bandwidth coefficient from input port} sets the option to specify bandwidth coefficient from input, {Bandwidth coefficient}, {Specify center frequency coefficient from input port} sets the option to specify center frequency coefficient from input, {Center frequency coefficient}, {Specify quality factor from input port} sets the option to specify quality factor from input, {Quality factor}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
